//: The engine wasm's split modules (docs/web-export.md §Modules): each module takes the functions whose demangled path, from its first non-std crate on, matches one of its patterns; the first module that matches wins. scripts/wasm-split.ts keeps in the primary every function a game using none of them runs (wasm-profile.ts) and every function `roots` reach up to `entries`, so such a game loads none.
//siblings: Modules built from one source per variant (og-physics' rigid/sim.rs, for dim2 and for dim3), whose identical bodies the linker folds under one name: a function one calls in the other goes to their parent (wasm-split.ts keepShared).
//roots: The engine's calls every game makes whatever it uses (scripts/wasm-split.ts framePath): a frame, the tick log the web host takes every tick, a canvas attach, a basic primitive geometry. Every function they reach by direct calls stays in the primary, stopping at `entries`.
//world3d: Not the 2D water (Water2d, water_2d_strips: the sprite order's strips) nor the terrains' effect group (terrain::fx), which every frame writes and binds: og-render draws a frame behind og-runtime's RenderBackend, a call the roots' graph does not follow, so an og-render function a module's pattern takes and every frame calls would load that module for every game.
//entries: The calls those make into a module only once the game uses it, each guarded in og-runtime (names without crate hashes): og.motion once og.MotionAgent is registered (engine/tick.rs render); set_mesh for a dynamic geometry's update, a streamed model's proxy and a destructible's hulls (generated geometry goes to physics' mesh source, bind/modules.rs note_mesh); the physics debug view; a video's stream once a video plays; og-runtime's terrain extraction, release, seabed and drop shadows once a terrain is loaded or named (present/extract/frame.rs uses_terrain, world/assets/release.rs); tilemap chunk quad building once a Tilemap entity exists; timeline tick stepping and material-track apply once a Timeline runs; active lockstep gate/after_tick once a peer joins a room. og-render makes its 3D world renderers through closures the frame path does not follow (renderer/resources.rs OnDemand), and its own guarded entries into render3d and smaa: the probe GI once a look enables it (pass_gi_probes.rs), the wind field and trample map once wind, a motor or a pusher drives them, a crowd's impostor bake once a crowd draws cards, and SMAA setup once antialias is Smaa/SmaaT2x.
